description: Engine dry mass correlation . m = (F / (g0 tw) * k_H2[cycle] + nozzle_kg_per_m2 * (Ae - 40 At) above 40:1) * pintle_factor + igniter, with tw = tw_at_pc_ref[cycle] * (F / 1 MN)^thrust_exponent * (pc / pc_ref_bar[cycle])^pc_exponent. k_H2 applies to LH2-fuelled engines only.
form: per-cycle hydrogen factor + pc term per cycle (pooled)

fit.prior: each tw_cycle pulled toward the v3 value (data.CYCLES tw) with the weight of one engine; each hydrogen cycle factor pulled toward the pooled factor with a log prior of width 0.25; each cycle's pc exponent pulled toward a common exponent with a prior of width 0.5; a cycle with no engine (electric_pump) gets the common exponent and keeps its v3 tw

year_form_comparison.form: per-cycle hydrogen factor + year term per cycle (pooled)
year_form_comparison.note: lower leave-one-out error than the pc form, but a design has no year, so the function uses the pc form

sources.engines: the flown engines table of the validation work; every published value there carries its own source URL
sources.fit_script: a least-squares fit to the flown engines (not shipped)

Merlin 1D (sea level).why: production-scale, low-margin design; +139% to +185% under every form tried (held out); the catalog engine 'Merlin 1D' carries its published 470 kg
